name: tracing
title: Tracing — ping-pong storms, traced in full
summary: The throughput storms with tracing on at full detail: every record read, encoded as OTLP protobuf, and let go.
description: The throughput scenario's ping-pong storms and ECMAScript pingers, with every system tracing at full detail (docs/adr/0006 in the repository root): after every slice the bench encodes each segment's records as OTLP protobuf (spans per macrostep and microstep, events per condition, send and assignment), as a host posting them would, and counts the bytes. Compare with `throughput`, or run any scenario with --param tracing=disabled|records|otlp.
